verdict.rationale: Institution coverage is a fair question for a financial-data connectivity platform like MX, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence publishes how many institutions MX reaches or which countries and regions it covers. The docs only describe connecting to end users' institutions in general terms and mention four sandbox test institutions, which is not production coverage.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform documents how many institutions it reaches and where — published coverage numbers and geographies I can check against where my users actually bank
